title: Chapter 01 — The Five Foundations of Economics
desc: Incentives, trade-offs, opportunity cost, marginal thinking and trade — four live models, spaced retrieval checkpoints and a chapter quiz.
h1: Five ideas that carry the whole course
intro: Every later chapter is one of these five wearing a different hat — supply and demand is trade-offs with a graph, elasticity is marginal thinking with a ratio. Read a chunk, then answer the checkpoint from memory before scrolling on.
